title: Your UPI App Just Got a Credit Boost: What NPCI CEO Dilip Asbe Announced
description: NPCI CEO Dilip Asbe has been highlighting a new initiative called 'UPI-linked Credit'. This allows banks to offer small, pre-approved credit lines directly th.

faq.a: Dilip Asbe is the Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer (MD & CEO) of the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), the organisation responsible for operating retail payment and settlement systems like UPI in India.

faq.q: What kind of credit limits can I expect with UPI-linked Credit?
faq.a: The credit limits will vary based on your bank or NBFC's assessment of your creditworthiness, but they are generally intended for small, everyday transactions and not large purchases.

faq.q: Will there be interest charges on UPI-linked Credit?
faq.a: Typically, there will be an interest-free period for repayment (e.g., 30-45 days). If the amount is not repaid within this period, interest charges will apply, similar to how credit cards work.

faq.q: Do I need a smartphone to use UPI-linked Credit?
faq.a: Yes, as this feature is integrated into your UPI app, a smartphone with internet access is generally required to use UPI-linked Credit.

faq.q: How do I apply for UPI-linked Credit?
faq.a: You would typically apply for this facility through your bank or a participating Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC), who would then link the approved credit line to your UPI ID.
